Author: Gweniaczek
Description:

[/s]﻿
Content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alterative Textures mod[/url]﻿. With this mod you will be able to use multiple designs of my buildings at the same time. 

Contains: barns, coops, junimo huts, fish ponds, mills, sheds, silos, slime hutches, stables, wells
( basically all buildings you would usually build multiple times on your farm c: )

[s]﻿                                                                                                                                                                            [/s]
[b]
[/b][b][color=#a2c4c9][size=4]Colour matching files for:
[/size][/color][/b]
- Vanilla ( original Stardew Valley palette ) 
- [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/580620-eemies-just-a-new-map-recolour-content-patcher-edition]Eemie's Just A New Map Recolour[/url]﻿
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]Starblue Valley[/url]﻿
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url]﻿
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2995]A Wittily Named Recolor
[/url]- Stardew Foliage Redone

[color=#a2c4c9][size=4][b]Installation:[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#e06666]SMAPI and Alternative Textures mod nedeed![/color]
1. Download the file matching your recolour mod ( or Vanilla )
2. Unzip/Extract
3. Paste '[AT] Medieval Buildings for [your choice]' folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder

[s]                                                                                                                                                                             [/s]

This mod is HEAVILY inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34984615?tab=about+me]Eemiestardew[/url]﻿ and using some of her wonderful creations.
Most of them are maintained and further developed by [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/profile/99667/mods]Minervamaga[/url]﻿.

[s]                                                                                                                                                                             [/s]

[/url]﻿Additional mods used in the screen -> [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8683]Paths[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8558]Fences[/url]﻿﻿[/center]
